[01 / ABOUT]{.eyebrow}

## An interdisciplinary perspective.
:::

::: {.about-copy}
I am an Associate Professor of Information Science in the Engineering Division at **Penn State Great Valley**. My scholarly work spans artificial intelligence and data analytics, with applications in health, enterprise systems, and environmental prediction.

My work with graduate students connects research with practical problems. Penn State has highlighted student projects I have mentored in big data and sports analytics.

[View my Penn State profile ↗](https://greatvalley.psu.edu/person/satish-mahadevan-srinivasan){.text-link}
:::
:::
